It is listed as a {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932|lt=Shikinaisha}}, and under the {{ill|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|Q712534|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|lt=former shrine ranking system}} it was classified as a gōsha. It is regarded as the tutelary shrine (ujigami) of the Akanabe area of Gifu City. {{nihongo|'''Akanabe Shrine'''|茜部神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Mino Province]].

== Enshrined deities ==
* {{ill|Emperor Ōjin|Q317997|qid=Q317997|qid=Q317997|lt=Hondawake no Mikoto}} (ほむたわけのみこと)
* {{ill|Empress Jingū|Q232803|qid=Q232803|lt=Okinaga Tarashihime no Mikoto}} (おきながたらしひめのみこと)
* {{ill|Takenouchi no Sukune|Q1073668|qid=Q1073668}} (たけうちすくね)
: Until {{ill|1868|Q7717|qid=Q7717}} (the first year of {{ill|Meiji era|ar|فترة مييجي|ast|Dómina Meiji|az|Meydzi dövrü|azb|مئی‌جی دؤورو|be|Перыяд Мэйдзі|bn|মেইজি যুগ|bo|མེའི་ཇིའི་དུས་དུས་མཚམས།|ca|Era Meiji|cs|Období Meidži|da|Meiji-perioden|de|Meiji-Zeit|el|Μεϊτζί (περίοδος)|es|Era Meiji|et|Meiji periood|eu|Meiji Aroa|fa|دوره میجی|fi|Meiji-kausi|fr|Ère Meiji|gl|Período Meiji|he|תקופת מייג'י|hr|Meiji (razdoblje)|ht|Epòk Meiji|hu|Meidzsi-kor|id|Zaman Meiji|io|Ero Meiji|is|Meiji-tímabilið|it|Periodo Meiji|ja|明治|ka|მეიძის ეპოქა|kbp|Mejii wɛɛ yaa alɩwaatʊ|kk|Мэйдзи дәуірі|ko|메이지 시대|la|Aetas Meiji|lt|Meidži laikotarpis|lv|Meidzi periods|mk|Меиџи (период)|mn|Мэйжийн эрин|ms|Zaman Meiji|nl|Meijiperiode|nn|Meiji|no|Meiji-perioden|pl|Meiji (okres)|pt|Era Meiji|ro|Perioada Meiji|ru|Мэйдзи|simple|Meiji period|sk|Obdobie Meidži|sq|Periudha Meixhi|sr|Меиџи период|sv|Meijiperioden|ta|மெய்சி காலம்|th|ยุคเมจิ|tl|Panahong Meiji|tr|Meiji Dönemi|uk|Період Мейдзі|ur|میجی دور|vi|Thời kỳ Minh Trị|war|Panahon Meiji|wuu|明治|zh|明治|zh_classical|明治|zh_min_nan|Bêng-tī|zh_yue|明治|qid=Q3125096}}), {{ill|Himegami|Q22070227|qid=Q22070227|lt=Hime Ōkami}} was enshrined.

== History ==
During the {{ill|Nara period|af|Nara-tydperk|ar|فترة نارا|bcl|Panahon nin Nara|bg|Нара (период)|bn|নারা যুগ|ca|Període Nara|ckb|سەردەمی نارا|cs|Období Nara|de|Nara-Zeit|el|Περίοδος Νάρα|eo|Epoko de Nara|es|Período Nara|eu|Nara aroa|fa|دوره نارا|fi|Nara-kausi|fr|Époque de Nara|gl|Período Nara|he|תקופת נארה|hr|Nara (razdoblje)|hu|Nara-kor|id|Zaman Nara|it|Periodo Nara|ja|奈良時代|jv|Periodhe Nara|ko|나라 시대|lt|Nara laikotarpis|ml|നാറ കാലഘട്ടം|ms|Zaman Nara|nl|Naraperiode|nn|Naratida|no|Nara-perioden|oc|Periòde de Nara|pl|Nara (okres)|ps|نارا|pt|Período Nara|ro|Perioada Nara|ru|Период Нара|sh|Nara period|simple|Nara period|sk|Obdobie Nara|sl|Obdobje Nara|sr|Нара период|sv|Naraperioden|th|ยุคนาระ|tl|Panahong Nara|tok|tenpo pi kulupu lawa Nala|tr|Nara Dönemi|uk|Період Нара|ur|نارا دور|vi|Thời kỳ Nara|war|Panahon Nara|wuu|奈良时代|zh|奈良時代|zh_min_nan|Nara sî-tāi|zh_yue|奈良時代|qid=Q189178}}, this area was the Tōdai-ji estate known as {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Atsumi Estate}} (later Akanabe Estate). Akanabe Shrine is said to have been founded in {{ill|830|Q30456|qid=Q30456}} (7th year of {{ill|Tenchō|Q1373138|qid=Q1373138}}) by the transfer (kanjō) of the deity from {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Usa Hachiman Shrine}}. It is considered one of the earlier shrines established as a branch of Usa Hachiman Shrine. The original enshrined deities were {{ill|Emperor Ōjin|Q317997|qid=Q317997|qid=Q317997|lt=Hondawake no Mikoto}}, {{ill|Empress Jingū|Q232803|qid=Q232803|lt=Okinaga Tarashihime no Mikoto}}, and {{ill|Himegami|Q22070227|qid=Q22070227|lt=Hime Ōkami}}. Later, in {{ill|833|Q30377|qid=Q30377}} (10th year of Tenchō), {{ill|Kūkai|Q222227|qid=Q222227}} established Jōju-in as a {{ill|Jingū-ji|Q1074971|qid=Q1074971}} (temple associated with the shrine).

During the {{ill|Nanboku-chō period|Q264012|qid=Q264012|lt=Nanboku-chō period}} and the {{ill|Sengoku period|Q204023|qid=Q204023|lt=Sengoku period}}, the shrine was regarded as the guardian deity of {{ill|Kawate Castle|Q2969463|qid=Q2969463}}, {{ill|Kamiakanabe Castle|Q17226097|qid=Q17226097}}, and {{ill|Kanō Castle|Q2969458|qid=Q2969458|lt=Kanō Castle}}, and was protected by the {{ill|Toki clan|Q687635|qid=Q687635}} and the {{ill|Saitō clan|Q2975353|qid=Q2975353}}. However, after the death of {{ill|Saitō Dōsan|Q1202670|qid=Q1202670}}, it was destroyed by fire in warfare in {{ill|1556|Q6590|qid=Q6590}} (2nd year of {{ill|Kōji (Muromachi period)|Q1143910|qid=Q1143910|lt=Kōji}}). It was later rebuilt and came under the protection of the {{ill|Oda clan|Q1132077|qid=Q1132077}}. During the {{ill|Edo period|Q184963|qid=Q184963}}, it was protected by successive lords of {{ill|Kanō Castle|Q2969458|qid=Q2969458}}.

In the early {{ill|Meiji era|ar|فترة مييجي|ast|Dómina Meiji|az|Meydzi dövrü|azb|مئی‌جی دؤورو|be|Перыяд Мэйдзі|bn|মেইজি যুগ|bo|མེའི་ཇིའི་དུས་དུས་མཚམས།|ca|Era Meiji|cs|Období Meidži|da|Meiji-perioden|de|Meiji-Zeit|el|Μεϊτζί (περίοδος)|es|Era Meiji|et|Meiji periood|eu|Meiji Aroa|fa|دوره میجی|fi|Meiji-kausi|fr|Ère Meiji|gl|Período Meiji|he|תקופת מייג'י|hr|Meiji (razdoblje)|ht|Epòk Meiji|hu|Meidzsi-kor|id|Zaman Meiji|io|Ero Meiji|is|Meiji-tímabilið|it|Periodo Meiji|ja|明治|ka|მეიძის ეპოქა|kbp|Mejii wɛɛ yaa alɩwaatʊ|kk|Мэйдзи дәуірі|ko|메이지 시대|la|Aetas Meiji|lt|Meidži laikotarpis|lv|Meidzi periods|mk|Меиџи (период)|mn|Мэйжийн эрин|ms|Zaman Meiji|nl|Meijiperiode|nn|Meiji|no|Meiji-perioden|pl|Meiji (okres)|pt|Era Meiji|ro|Perioada Meiji|ru|Мэйдзи|simple|Meiji period|sk|Obdobie Meidži|sq|Periudha Meixhi|sr|Меиџи период|sv|Meijiperioden|ta|மெய்சி காலம்|th|ยุคเมจิ|tl|Panahong Meiji|tr|Meiji Dönemi|uk|Період Мейдзі|ur|میجی دور|vi|Thời kỳ Minh Trị|war|Panahon Meiji|wuu|明治|zh|明治|zh_classical|明治|zh_min_nan|Bêng-tī|zh_yue|明治|qid=Q3125096|lt=Meiji period}}, due to the {{ill|Haibutsu kishaku|Q702298|qid=Q702298}} (abolition of Buddhism and destruction of Buddhist images), Jōju-in was abolished. In {{ill|1868|Q7717|qid=Q7717}} (the first year of Meiji), one of the enshrined deities, Hime Ōkami, was replaced with Takenouchi no Sukune. The annual festival was originally held on October 15, but in {{ill|1950|Q18597|qid=Q18597}} (25th year of {{ill|Shōwa era|Q327567|qid=Q327567}}) it was changed to April 5. This change was made to coincide with the {{ill|Gifu Matsuri|Q11471288|qid=Q11471288}} (the annual festival of {{ill|Inaba Shrine|Q701414|qid=Q701414}}).
